As the Turkish Super Lig heats up, Fenerbahçe prepares to host Kasımpaşa in what promises to be an exhilarating encounter at Şükrü Saracoğlu Stadium. This match pits two teams against each other who have had varying levels of success this season. Fenerbahçe currently sits in the top half of the table, battling for European football, while Kasımpaşa fights to break free from the relegation zone in the closing stages of the league. Both teams come into this fixture needing crucial points, making this clash essential for their respective goals. Kick-off: 23.02.2026, 17:00 UTC / 20:00 MSK
Stadium: Şükrü Saracoğlu Stadium
Competition: Turkish Super Lig

Match Preview

Fenerbahçe has been showing solid form as they approach the business end of the Super Lig season, with their attack led by the likes of Enner Valencia, who has consistently found the back of the net. Coach Jorge Jesus has implemented a tactical approach that emphasizes quick transitions and maintaining possession, which has paid dividends, particularly at home. However, they will need to address some minor defensive lapses if they are to secure a vital three points against Kasımpaşa. On the other hand, Kasımpaşa is grappling with inconsistency, and their recent form reflects that struggle. With several key injuries affecting their squad depth, manager Selçuk İnan will have to rely on the resilience of his players. Having picked up points in recent games, Kasımpaşa’s confidence may boost their chances of pulling off an upset. The team’s ability to counteract Fenerbahçe's high press could be pivotal in shaping the outcome of this match.

Team Form and Analysis

Fenerbahçe

Fenerbahçe's defense has shown resilience, although it has been occasionally undone by set pieces. Their attacking prowess remains intact with Valencia and İrfan Can Kahveci leading the charge. Injuries have been minimal, with only a couple of fringe players sidelined. The return of experienced defender Min-jae Kim will bolster their backline significantly.

Kasımpaşa

Kasımpaşa's defense has been a glaring weakness this season, with frequent lapses allowing opponents to exploit their vulnerabilities. The effective attacking partnership of Karamoko and Hadergjonaj is crucial, but they will face a tough Fenerbahçe defense. Injuries have particularly affected their midfield, as both Hassan Kachloul and Kone remain doubtful for this showdown. Their expected tactic of playing two banks of four may provide them some stability against a formidable Fenerbahçe side.
